description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part is the Lug Nut Stud that fits into the Drum and receives the lug nut after the wheel has been mounted.
It is part number 09119-12006.
To replace all studs it requires 5 studs per drum.
These are for the REAR wheels only.
The front wheels require a different type stud part #09119-12008, which we also sell.
To purchase that item select the Wheels/Spare Tire Category in the far left column.
Note: Color May vary
What Will I Receive?
Qty 10 – Lug Nut Studs (Rear Wheel)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1988 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1988 – 1995 All Models
